title: SophisticatedStorage issue #639: Odd Factory Gauge Behavior When Paired With Sophisticated Storage

text:
[issue by KitsuneNoMeiji]
### Description

As the name suggests, there is a strange issue when paired with Sophisticated Storage. The Factory Gauge seems to detect a maximum of 1 stack of an item in a Storage Controller when placed separately from a Packager connected to it. However, when placed on said Packager, it displays the correct number, which indicates it SHOULD be working, no? You can see examples in the following pictures. I wasn't sure which mod author(s) to report this to, as I'm not sure on whose end the bug is created.

Note: I noticed the Sophisticated mods had an update. I tried updating, but the issue persisted.

[comment by P3pp3rF1y (owner)]
This looks like an issue in Create where it uses extract method to judge how much there is of an item and only gets maxstacksize back. And I see you have reported this on Create side as well so I am going to close here. If out of investigation on Create side it's obvious that it's a bug in Sophisticated feel free to reopen.
